sections.label: MOE view on bullying
sections.summary: MOE takes a serious view of bullying, and schools monitor discipline and use educative, preventive and intervention measures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: MOE takes a serious view on any form of bullying, including cyber and gender-based bullying.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Schools monitor the school environment and discipline closely, and take educative, preventive and intervention measures to address bullying incidents.

sections.label: Investigating reported bullying cases
sections.summary: When bullying is reported, trained school personnel investigate, provide counselling and decide on disciplinary action.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: When alleged bullying is reported, trained school personnel investigate and provide counselling support for students involved and decide on appropriate disciplinary action.

sections.label: Teacher training on bullying
sections.summary: MOE provides training for student and trained teachers, and is strengthening senior teachers' training and schools' capacity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Training on positive classroom culture and classroom management is core for all student teachers at the National Institute of Education.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: For trained teachers in schools, they are given refresher training through online modules, school-based and MOE workshops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: To further equip some senior teachers to handle complex bullying cases, MOE is strengthening their training in fostering positive class culture, investigating and addressing online and offline bullying.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: We are also deepening schools' capacity to help students protect themselves better online, and work with parents and the community to educate our young.﻿
